title: Meet transcripts to the record? Turn them on (WS-98), and Jose's automation agent delivers them to the private vault (WS-96)
detail: Affects everyone: every stand-up's record. Proposed by conductor@web-summit.jose, agreed by Jose (5 November: "yes, go"). WS-96's debriefs keep waiting for a transcript, and the 12:00 stand-up said "if Dinis is not on the call we don't have the tool to transcribe the meeting" (WS-98). Proposal: (1) Dinis turns on Meet transcripts or Gemini notes for the organisation, so whoever organises the call gets a transcript in their Drive (WS-98); (2) automation@web-summit.jose builds an n8n flow that takes each new transcript into a private vault lane, never the public repository, for team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo to draft the record from, as the agents settled on 4 November (one writer for the agenda, one for the record; WS-107, who confirms, is still open); no new transcript agent. Raw transcripts stay in the private vault; only decisions in the decider's own words (WS-107) and follow-ups come to data/meetings/. Everyone on the call is told it is transcribed.
recommend: Yes: Dinis turns on transcripts (WS-98); Angelo says which vault lane team-collaboration reads; automation@web-summit.jose builds the flow
options: yes: transcripts on, and Jose's automation agent delivers them
transcripts on; Angelo's team-collaboration fetches them itself
not now: a named note-taker each stand-up
